name: @frank/adaptor-signatures
description: ECDSA adaptor signatures ("scriptless scripts") over secp256k1. Standalone crypto primitive, not yet wired into any wallet/message code -- see README.md for the full writeup: spec/paper citations, dlcspecs test-vector conformance status, the side-channel hardening pass, the nonce-generation design decision, and the two planned Frank integration points (blackjack-bot payout, DEX/atomic-swap settlement). Implements the DLEQ-based ECDSA adaptor signature construction from the discreetlogcontracts/dlcspecs ECDSA-adaptor.md spec (Fournier + Aumayr et al.), plus an added Schnorr proof-of-knowledge of the tweak secret so the construction is sound outside the DLC-only context that spec restricts itself to. NOT externally security-reviewed -- see README.md's security-status section before using this with real funds.
